description: One-shot backfill verb that walks the operator's Claude Code on the web session surface via three documented endpoints on api.anthropic.com: GET /v1/sessions?beta=true&limit=100 (paginated via next_page), GET /v1/sessions/<id>?beta=true (per-session metadata), GET /v1/session_ingress/session/<id> (full transcript loglines). Reads the OAuth bearer from the macOS Keychain entry 'Claude Code-credentials' (JSON envelope at claudeAiOauth.accessToken — populated by `claude auth login`). Sends headers anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 + anthropic-beta: managed-agents-2026-04-01 per the current Managed Agents API surface. Computes SET DIFFERENCE against ledger sessions already ingested under vendor='claude_code' so re-runs are idempotent — already-fetched session IDs are skipped. The force=True flag overrides SET DIFFERENCE and re-fetches every session (operator diagnostic / repair path). Each session's transcript is wrapped in a JSON envelope and dispatched through the existing push-mode importer seam under IngestSourceKind.CLAUDE_CODE_CLOUD; the parser reuses vendor.claude_code (the local rollout JSONL parser) because the cloud transcript loglines are byte-equivalent to the local shape. Returns a structured summary with listed_count + fetched_count + skipped_count + errored_count + errors. Cross-source dedupe via the W5.B canonical-pointer pattern at (vendor='claude_code', external_session_id=session_id) collapses overlap with claude_code_local once the operator has teleported a cloud session to disk.
embedding_description: One-shot backfill of Claude Code Cloud sessions into the session ledger: walk the paginated cloud sessions API, fetch each session's transcript in parallel with rate-limit backoff, and skip anything the ledger already holds. Authenticates with the stored claude.ai OAuth credential. Deduplicates against locally captured Claude Code sessions.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Backfill summary: status ('completed' | 'auth_expired' | 'rate_limited' | 'failed' | other token), listed_count (sessions seen on the list endpoint), fetched_count (sessions fetched and ingested this run), skipped_count (sessions already in ledger via SET DIFFERENCE), errored_count (per-session failures), errors (newline-joined per-session error tokens).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the backfill outcome to the operator in plain English: 'Claude Code Cloud backfill: listed N sessions, fetched K new, skipped M already-ingested; encountered E errors.' If status is auth_expired surface 'claude.ai OAuth bearer in Keychain has expired — please re-run `claude auth login` and retry the verb.' If status is rate_limited surface 'sustained HTTP 429 from api.anthropic.com; retry the verb after a few minutes.'

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Claude Code Cloud bearer-cell backfill walker invocation.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: auth_missing — macOS Keychain entry 'Claude Code-credentials' not present; operator has not run `claude auth login`, or the plugin is running on a non-macOS host (cloud solet credential transfer path not yet implemented). auth_unreadable — Keychain entry present but the `security find-generic-password` shell-out failed. auth_malformed — Keychain entry present but the JSON envelope is missing the configured token path (claudeAiOauth.accessToken); re-run `claude auth login`. auth_expired — api.anthropic.com returned HTTP 401; bearer expired; re-run `claude auth login`. rate_limited — api.anthropic.com returned sustained HTTP 429 across the configured retry budget. list_failed — GET /v1/sessions returned a non-200 status or unparseable payload. fetch_failed — GET /v1/session_ingress/session/<id> returned a non-200 status for a specific session. summary_malformed — list endpoint returned a row missing the 'id' field. config_missing — plugin.yaml config malformed. importer_missing — session_ledger_service unavailable at verb invocation time. failed — any other unexpected exception during the walk.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For auth_* errors: have the operator re-run `claude auth login` interactively (full-scope token, NOT setup-token) and retry. For rate_limited: wait a few minutes and re-fire the verb (the SET DIFFERENCE skip will avoid re-fetching the sessions already landed). For list_failed / fetch_failed: inspect the surfaced HTTP status; transient backend issues resolve on retry, persistent issues warrant operator investigation against the documented endpoint catalog in workbench/2026-06-13_claude_code_web_phase_a_discovery.md. For config_missing: inspect plugins/claude_code_cloud_session_source_plugin/plugin.yaml against the documented config keys (keychain_service, keychain_envelope_path, api_base_url, anthropic_version, anthropic_beta, list_page_limit, walker_concurrency, fetch_timeout_seconds, rate_limit_backoff_seconds). For importer_missing: verify the platform initialized session_ledger_service (startup_sequence._init_session_ledger_service); do not add it to service_bindings.json, because it is not a service-binding ServiceName.
